title: Text messages obtained by journalist Aaron Parnas from a sailor aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln describe worsening conditions during the carrier’s prolonged deployment tied to operations against Iran.
text:
Text messages obtained by journalist Aaron Parnas from a sailor aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln describe worsening conditions during the carrier’s prolonged deployment tied to operations against Iran."

"The sailor reported shortages of fresh food and basic supplies, saying the crew had gone three months without milk and received little fresh food besides meat, while some shipments arrived rotten."
